question: What housing measures did Spain approve in response to the 87-year-old woman eviction protests in Madrid?

question: Why would a US diesel export ban likely increase gasoline prices rather than lower them?
transcript_excerpt: If the US cannot export diesel, refiners cannot get a good price for their diesel and will cut back production. When crude oil is processed, it produces diesel, gasoline, and jet fuel simultaneously. Cutting back production means less of all three products, including gasoline which is politically more sensitive and what most Americans use.
